gates.label: Registry structure and cross-references
gates.acceptance: No parse, schema, duplicate-id, broken-reference, artifact-path or priority-score error.

gates.label: Operational source-universe saturation
gates.acceptance: Every required facet occurs in a saturated scope cell; every search surface has a reproducible run; every result is screened; two consecutive backward/forward citation-chase rounds yield zero included sources; two independent approvals exist; no candidate source remains undecided.

gates.label: Verified bibliographic and ancient-source identity
gates.acceptance: Every included source has bibliography_verified or authority_verified identity, canonical identifiers where available, no unresolved identity issue, and independent passing identity reviews from distinct evidence chains.

gates.label: Edition, artifact and page-map reproducibility
gates.acceptance: Every included evidence-bearing source resolves to an archived_verified or public_canonical fingerprinted artifact; abstract ancient works are backed by registered witness or edition evidence; secondary page maps are visually verified.

gates.label: Atomic claim and locus coverage
gates.acceptance: Every included source has verified atomic evidence units or a doubly adjudicated no-relevant-evidence decision; no source remains unknown, none, metadata-only or partial.

gates.label: Ancient locus and secondary page precision
gates.acceptance: Every active ancient unit has a canonical locus and named edition/witness; every active secondary unit has printed pages and a visually verified PDF page map; every verbatim claim has a corpus id or SHA-256.

gates.label: Independent double verification
gates.acceptance: Every active evidence unit and every resolved/adjudicated factual issue has passing primary and independent reviews by distinct verifier ids and independence groups.

gates.label: Adversarial refutation
gates.acceptance: Every active evidence unit and resolved/adjudicated factual issue has a passing adversarial review that searched counter-evidence, variants, misattribution and anachronism.

gates.label: Zero known factual error or unresolved factual risk
gates.acceptance: No factual-risk issue is open, investigating or blocked; every factual adjudication has a decision, evidence and current independent verification.

gates.label: Current-snapshot KG and corpus integrity
gates.acceptance: All required commands pass against recorded current input hashes and a regression verification event records the artifacts.
required_commands: cd frontend && npm test -- --run && npm run build && npm run test:seo && node scripts/test-workspace-splitting.mjs

gates.label: Human scholarly release sign-off
gates.acceptance: Two named human scholars in distinct independence groups sign the exact registry, KG, corpus and bibliography hashes after all other gates pass.
